title: Systematic Analysis of In Vitro Cell Rolling Using a Multi-well Plate Microfluidic System
protocol: Culture HL-60 cells in 75 cm2 flasks with 15 ml of Iscove's Modified Dulbecco's Medium (IMDM).
Supplement the medium with 20% fetal bovine serum, 1% L-Glutamine, and 1% Penicillin-Streptomycin.
Change media every 3 days by aspirating half of the cell suspension volume.
Replace aspirated volume with fresh complete IMDM media.
For CFSE staining, centrifuge HL-60 cells at 400 x g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cells in a 1 μM CFSE solution prepared in prewarmed PBS and incubate for 15 min at 37 °C.
Centrifuge the stained cells again at 400 x g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend cells in fresh, pre-warmed medium.
Incubate for an additional 30 minutes.
Wash cells twice with PBS before use in rolling experiments.
Coat 100 mm Petri dishes with a 0.1% gelatin solution in PBS.
Incubate the coated plates at 37 °C for at least 30 min.
Culture LMVECs on gelatin-coated 100 mm Petri dishes in complete endothelial growth medium (EBM-2) supplemented with specific growth supplements.
Change media every other day.
Subculture cells upon reaching 80-90% confluence by washing cells with PBS.
Detatch cells with 4 ml of 1x Trypsin-EDTA for 3 min at 37 °C and neutralize in an equal volume of complete EBM-2 media.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15 ml tube and centrifuge (400 x g, 5 min).
Resuspend the pellet in 1 ml of complete endothelial medium and count cells with a hemocytometer.
Culture CHO-P cells in T175 cm2 flasks in F-12 media.
Passage cells by washing with PBS for 4-5 sec.
Trypsinize cells in 10 ml of 1x Trypsin-EDTA for 3 min at 37 °C and neutralize in full media.
Centrifuge the cell suspension (400 x g, 5 min).
Resuspend the pellet in 1 ml of full media and count the cells with a hemocytometer.
Connect the computer to the controller.
Turn on the inverted microscope.
Activate the CCD camera.
Open the imaging software and ensure all modules are displayed correctly.
Attach tubes to the vapor trap connected to the controller.
Connect tubes to the Pressure Interface.
Place a multi-well plate in the plate heater/adaptor.
Add reagents to the wells as specified.
Install the interface on top of the multi-well plate.
Apply pneumatic pressure from the controller through the interface to drive fluid flow.
Control the flow rate manually using the multi-well plate module screen.
Position the multi-well plate for imaging on the automated stage.
Acquire videos using a CCD camera at 11 frames per second.
Analyze the acquired videos via compatible software.
Coat microfluidic channels with fibronectin or P-/E-selectin.
Prepare 1 ml of 20 μg/ml fibronectin solution in PBS.
Alter volume based on the number of channels to be coated (use 25-50 μl of fibronectin per channel).
Add 25-50 μl of fibronectin solution to each inlet well.
Apply shear force of 2 dyn/cm² for 5 min to perfuse the channel.
Incubate for 30-45 min at room temperature.
Aspirate the solution from wells (do not aspirate directly from the middle circle that feeds the channel).
Add 200-500 μl of PBS into outlet well.
Wash channel with PBS by applying shear flow of 2 dyn/cm² for 5 min.
To coat with P- or E-sel, prepare a 5 μg/ml solution of the desired human recombinant protein in PBS.
Coat the channels as described above, with 1 hr incubation at 37 °C to allow surface coating.
Gently trypsinize cells from culture dishes for 3 min.
Quench using a 2-fold volume of full media and centrifuge (5 min at 400 x g).
Resuspend cells with 10 ml of full media.
Centrifuge (5 min at 400 x g) again.
Count the cells to determine cell concentration in the suspension.
Bring cell concentration to 15-20 million cells/ml for a confluent LMVEC monolayer.
Use 50-60 million cells/ml for a confluent CHO-P cell monolayer.
Add 25-50 μl of cell suspension at appropriate concentration to the inlet well.
Place the plate on the microscope stage and introduce cells into the channel until observed filling the entire channels, then stop the flow.
Fill both outlet and inlet with 200 μl of either full LMVEC or CHO media.
Let the cells settle and adhere for 3 hr in the incubator (37 °C, 5% CO2).
Wash the channel with full media at 2 dyn/cm2 for 10-15 min to remove unattached cells.
Cells should now appear completely confluent, making the channel ready for use.
Prepare a TNF-α solution at a concentration of 10 ng/ml in LMVEC basal media.
Add 100 μl of TNF-α solution to the inlet well and introduce into the channel with shear flow of 2 dyn/cm² for 5 minutes to activate LMVECs.
For control channels, add 100 μl of LMVEC basal media to the inlet well and introduce into the channel under the same conditions (shear flow of 2 dyn/cm² for 5 minutes).
Introduce neutralizing P-sel antibodies (clone AK4, 5 μg/ml in basal media) or E-sel antibodies (clone P2H3, 5 μg/ml in basal media) into the channel and incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour.
Wash channels with basal media under shear flow of 2 dyn/cm² for 5 minutes to remove excess antibodies.
Carefully examine the channels under a microscope to confirm proper coating or fully confluent cell monolayer formation.
Centrifuge HL-60 cell suspension (5 minutes at 400 x g) and wash once with basal media.
Count cells and resuspend in IMDM (basal media containing Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺) to create a HL-60 cell suspension of 5 million cells/ml.
Use 25-50 μl of the prepared HL-60 cell suspension for each channel to perform the rolling assay.
Add 25-50 μl of the cell suspension to outlet well.
Place plate inside the temperature-controlled plate holder (37 °C).
Place the plate on the microscope stage.
Apply shear force of 2 dyn/cm² to introduce cells into the channel.
Reduce shear to 0.25 dyn/cm² and acquire 20-30 sec videos.
Gradually increase shear from 0.25 up to 5 dyn/cm² and acquire videos in each desired shear.
Acquire videos using a CCD camera (11 frames/sec).
Analyze rolling paths and rolling velocities via compatible software.
Trypsinize cells to prepare a cell suspension of desired cell type (HL-60, CHO-P or LMVECs) in PBS (-/-), supplemented with 2% FBS.
Wash cells twice.
Bring sample volume to 50 μl using the same buffer.
Incubate each sample with fluorophore-conjugated Ab at 4 °C for 20 min (cover with aluminum foil).
Wash the cells twice using the same buffer.
Bring final volume of stained cell suspension to 200 μl.
Analyze samples using a flow cytometer to detect expression of surface molecules.
